topic.title: Jeff Bezos takes a five-figure salary from Amazon while Amazon pays far more for his security

shape.name: The small paycheck
shape.beats: hook: the famous name's tiny salary next to a bigger cost the company pays for them -> the asker: why so small? -> a comparison salary (another boss's) -> where the real money is (a stake) -> its size, sourced -> the turn: how many years of salary it equals -> payoff: the cost against the salary, and paycheck or shares?
shape.why: a billionaire whose paycheck is tiny because the fortune is a stake the company can't pay him; fits Bezos, Zuckerberg, Buffett
